request: tenants who are months behind. each tenant has a rent and the date up to which they have paid. show how many months overdue each one is, the money they owe, total arrears, and a button to move paid-till forward by a month when they pay
checklist: 1. add a tenant with rent and paid-till date
5. button to advance paid-till by a month
program:
app "Arrears" key ocean
table tenant name text, rent money, paidtill date
let behind(t tenant) = max(floor((today - t.paidtill) / 30), 0)
topbar "Tenants", tenant, "Add tenant"
statcard sum(tenant, behind(it) * it.rent), "arrears in total"
each tenant sort paidtill as t empty "No tenants yet. Add the first tenant."
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t fill if(behind(t) > 0, warn, soft)
    stack grow gap 0
      t.name bold
      "paid till" t.paidtill "·" plural(behind(t), "month") "behind" faint
    behind(t) * t.rent bold
    button "Paid" tap set t.paidtill = addmonths(t.paidtill, 1)

request: balcony plants, each needs water at its own rhythm, ferns every 2 days, cactus every 14. list plants with how often to water, a button that says watered, how many days since the last water, and flag the ones that are overdue
checklist: 1. add a plant with watering interval
program:
app "Plants" plant teal
table plant name text, every num 1..30 = 3 "Water every (days)"
table water plant ref plant
let thirsty = count(plant, due(it.water, it.every))
topbar "Plants", plant, "Add plant"
statcard thirsty, "plants need water", count(plant)
each plant sort name as p empty "No plants yet. Add the first one."
  stack card gap 1 tap edit p swipe remove p fill if(due(p.water, p.every), warn, soft)
    row gap 2
      p.name bold grow
      button "Watered" tap add water plant = p
    "Every" p.every "days · last watered" since(p.water) "days ago" faint
    weekdots count(p.water on it) > 0

request: freelance editor. i bill by the hour at 1500 so i log a job with client and time spent, show what is unpaid, hours worked this week and let me switch between all jobs and only the unpaid ones. tick when a client pays
checklist: 1. log a job with client and time spent
2. amount billed from hours and rate
program:
app "Billable hours" pen green
table job client text, work dur = 1h, paid bool
setting rate money = 1500 "Rate per hour"
state show pick All|Unpaid = Unpaid
let worth(j job) = j.work / 1h * rate
topbar "Jobs", job, "Log job"
row gap 2
  statcard sum(job where paid = no, worth(it)), "unpaid"
  statcard sum(job.work week) / 1h, "hours this week"
choice show
each job where show = All or paid = no sort at desc as j empty "No jobs here. Log one with Log job."
  row card gap 2 tap edit j swipe remove j
    stack grow gap 0
      j.client bold
      j.work faint
    worth(j) bold
    toggle j.paid

request: I have three side projects and one free evening a week, so I need to see where the minutes really go. add projects, tap +30 or +60 minutes after a session, set a weekly minutes goal and see bars per project this week and total against the goal
program:
app "Side projects" bolt yellow
table proj name text
table session proj ref proj, mins num 5..240
setting goal num = 240 "Weekly minutes"
topbar "Side projects", proj, "Add project"
goal sum(session.mins week), goal, "minutes this week", "min"

each proj sort name as p empty "No projects yet. Add the ones you want time for."

    p.name bold grow
    button "+30" tap add session proj = p, mins = 30

request: disaster recovery drills: name of the drill, target recovery time in minutes and the time it really took. pass when actual is within target. bars to compare target and actual for each drill and a count of passes
checklist: 1. log a drill with name, target minutes and actual minutes
program:
app "DR drills" shield yellow
table drill name text, target num 1.. unit "min", actual num 1.. unit "min"
topbar "DR drills", drill, "Log drill"
statcard count(drill where actual <= target), "of" count(drill) "drills met their target", count(drill)
each drill sort at desc as d empty "No drills yet. Run one and write down how long recovery took."
  stack card gap 1 tap edit d swipe remove d
    row gap 1
      d.name bold grow
      if(d.actual <= d.target, "Passed", "Missed") bold color if(d.actual <= d.target, good, bad)
    draw 100, 10
      rect 0, 0, 100 * d.target / max(d.target, d.actual), 4 fill muted radius 2
      rect 0, 6, 100 * d.actual / max(d.target, d.actual), 4 fill if(d.actual <= d.target, good, bad) radius 2
    "Target" d.target "min · took" d.actual "min" faint

request: did I code today? one button, streak and a grid of the last 6 weeks
checklist: 1. one tap to mark coded today
program:
app "Code streak" flame orange
table code
statcard streak(code), "day streak, best" best(code)
button if(count(code today) > 0, "Coded today", "I coded today") fill if(count(code today) > 0, good, accent) tap toggle code today
section "Last 6 weeks", join(count(code last 42 days), " days")
  daygrid last 42 days, count(code on it)

request: revising for the entrance test with spaced repetition. for each topic i keep the last revised date and how many times i revised it. the next revision gap doubles each time, so it is 2 to the power of the count in days. show topics due today and a button to say revised
checklist: 2. next revision date from doubling gaps
program:
app "Revision" brain plum
table card topic text, seen date = today, rev num 0..8 = 0 "Times revised"
let nextday(c card) = c.seen + pow(2, c.rev)
topbar "Topics", card, "Add topic"
statcard count(card, nextday(it) <= today), "topics due for revision", count(card)
each card sort seen as c empty "No topics yet. Add what you are revising."
  row card gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c fill if(nextday(c) <= today, warn, soft)
    stack grow gap 0
      c.topic bold
      "revised" c.rev "times · next" nextday(c) faint
    button "Revised" tap set c.rev = c.rev + 1 then set c.seen = today

request: passports, cnics, driving licenses for the whole family and half of them are close to expiring. add a document with name, owner and expiry date, show how many expire within 6 months, colour expired ones red and the next 90 days orange, and remind me a month before
checklist: 1. add a document with owner and expiry date
3. expired red and next 90 days orange
program:
app "Documents" shield pink
table doc name text, owner text, expires date
let soon = count(doc where expires >= today and expires - today <= 180)
topbar "Documents", doc, "Add document"
row gap 2
  statcard soon, "expire in 6 months"
  statcard count(doc where expires < today), "already expired"
remind "A document expires in a month" at doc.expires - 30d at 9:00
each doc sort expires as d empty "No documents yet. Add the ones that have an expiry date."
  row card gap 2 tap edit d swipe remove d fill if(d.expires < today, bad, if(d.expires - today <= 90, warn, soft))
    stack grow gap 0
      d.name bold
      d.owner "· expires" d.expires faint
    d.expires - today "days" bold

request: funnel for our signup flow: I type the steps in order (landing, signup, verify email, first project) and the number of people who reached each one. draw each step as a bar relative to the first and tell me the percent that survive to the end
checklist: 1. add a step with its order and number of users
2. bar for each step relative to the first
3. percent of users kept at each step
4. overall conversion from first to last step
program:
app "Funnel" chart green
table step name text, ord num 1..12 "Order", users num 0..
let top = max(step.users)
let first_step = first(step.users where ord = min(step.ord))
topbar "Onboarding funnel", step, "Add step"
statcard round(last(step.users where ord = max(step.ord)) * 100 / max(first_step, 1)), "% make it from first step to last", 100
each step sort ord as s empty "No steps yet. Add the screens people pass through, in order."
  stack gap 0
    row gap 1
      s.ord s.name bold grow
      s.users "·" round(s.users * 100 / max(top, 1)) "%" faint
    draw 100, 6
      rect 0, 0, 100, 6 fill soft radius 3
      rect 0, 0, 100 * s.users / max(top, 1), 6 fill accent radius 3

request: took a loan for the bike. 12 instalments, i pay 10000 each when i can. log each payment, show how much of the loan is still left, how many instalments remain and the date the next one is due, which comes a month after the last. loan size and number of instalments should be changeable.

setting loan money = 120000 "Loan taken"

request: customer claims SLA credit. I type the month's availability percent and their monthly fee, tiers: under 99.9 gives 10 percent back, under 99 gives 25 percent, under 95 gives 50 percent. show the credit amount and which tier applies, and keep a list of credits I gave
checklist: 4. save the credit given with customer name
program:
app "SLA credit" calc purple
table credit customer text, amount money
state avail num = 99.95
state fee money = 1000
state who text = ""
let pct = if(avail < 95, 50, if(avail < 99, 25, if(avail < 99.9, 10, 0)))
section "Availability this month", join(avail, "%")
  slider avail 90..100
  field fee "Monthly fee"
statcard fee * pct / 100, "credit due (" pct "% tier)"
if pct = 0
  "SLA met, no credit owed." faint
else
  field who "Customer"
  button "Save credit given" fill accent tap add credit customer = who, amount = fee * pct / 100
list credit, "No credits given yet."

request: after each sprint I want to note what we planned and what we really finished in points. show a chart of finished points per sprint, the average velocity and what percent of the plan we complete, so I can stop overcommitting
checklist: 1. add a sprint with planned and finished points
2. bar chart of finished points per sprint

request: choosing between Postgres, Mongo and Dynamo. I list options, list criteria with weights 1 to 5, then give each option a score per criterion. total weighted score per option, highest on top
program:
app "Decision" scale ocean
table option name text
table crit name text, weight num 1..5 = 3
table rating option ref option, crit ref crit, score num 1..5 = 3
topbar "Decision matrix", option, "Add option"
section "Criteria", count(crit)
  each crit as c empty "Add criteria like cost or speed first."
    row gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
      c.name grow
      "weight" c.weight faint
  form crit, "Add criterion"
each option sort sum(it.rating, it.score * it.crit.weight) desc as o empty "Add the options you are comparing."
  row card gap 2 swipe remove o
    o.name bold grow
    sum(o.rating, it.score * it.crit.weight) big
form rating, "Add score"

request: daily pulse check for my team: how is everyone feeling, tap 1 to 5 and see the average today, the week as a line chart and how many answers so far
program:
app "Pulse" smile mint
table mood score num 1..5
statcard round(avg(mood.score today) * 10) / 10, "average mood today from" plural(count(mood today), "answer")
row gap 1
  each 1..5
    button it fill if(it >= 4, good, if(it = 3, soft, warn)) grow tap add mood score = it
